source_snapshot.procedure: Upgrade or downgrade BMC while the system is power off/standby.
source_snapshot.criteria: Firmware flashes through supported protocols and BMC resets exactly once.
source_snapshot.script: Private system power-control and Redfish firmware-check repositories. Fifteen minutes attended and fifteen machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes chassis power off/status with credentials in arguments, but does not define standby, drain workloads, preserve baseline, prove BMC reachability or cover the flash itself.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at CRITICAL risk; treat this row as the approved standby precondition/handoff for a separately controlled BMC flash.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally recognizes state change and service interruption but its status-only evidence and secret handling are inadequate.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates standby preparation from firmware mutation and adds workload/storage, BMC reachability and handoff gates.
historical_reviews.history: V003 RTM thermal and related passive display cases are excluded by version, row and variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Power control requires exact state semantics, target identity, clean writes, explicit approval, recovery and no inferred AC/force action.

original_test_intent: Place the approved host into the exact standby state required for a BMC firmware upgrade/downgrade, prove host power is off while BMC remains reachable, and hand off protected evidence to the separate flash workflow.
original_method: Verify target and active writes, preserve baseline, drain workloads and storage cleanly, perform the documented graceful/bounded chassis-off action under approval, poll authoritative state and confirm stable BMC reachability without removing AC power.
manual_activity: The owner defines standby and approves service interruption and flash handoff; an operator supervises workload drain, shutdown and console/BMC state while automation collects protected state transitions.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC and current chassis state
Vendor meaning of standby and supported power method
Separate approved BMC image/workflow and handoff policy
safety_requirements: Never interrupt unknown writes or active firmware task
Prefer documented graceful shutdown when required
Do not equate chassis off with AC removal or BMC reset
Keep BMC reachable and credentials protected
Stop on ambiguous state, BMC loss or abnormal power/thermal/storage event
Do not begin flash without separate handoff approval
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, jobs, storage and firmware state
Issue only the approved graceful/bounded power-off once
Poll authoritative chassis state and BMC reachability
Preserve standby handoff evidence without flashing, powering on or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Approve service interruption and flash handoff

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable to chassis state, but unsafe credential handling and a grepped status cannot prove clean shutdown, exact standby semantics, BMC reachability or flash readiness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented protected IPMI/Redfish power method only after workload/storage drain and state semantics are approved; preserve the flash as a separate controlled step.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Standby-before-BMC-flash purpose, single-reset flash criterion, scripts and 15/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds graceful shutdown, exact state semantics, protected secrets and explicit separation from flash.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This record proves the standby precondition, not BMC flash success by itself.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong power semantics can corrupt data or remove the BMC access needed for recovery.

project_override_considerations: The project may select OS shutdown, IPMI or Redfish chassis-off, but must prove it yields the required standby rails and BMC reachability; AC removal, force-off or reset require separate approval.
expected_evidence: Approval, target and pre-power workload/storage/firmware state
Redacted power command/audit and state-transition timestamps
Console shutdown evidence and authoritative standby interpretation
Stable post-off BMC reachability and no-AC/no-extra-reset proof
Separate flash handoff/recovery readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The V004 row consistently defines standby as the operating condition for BMC flashing. V003 RTM sensor history is a different version and identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: State semantics, power method and flash handoff are finite vendor/owner inputs; after supply, the controlled transition is feasible.

review_improvement: Hardens DeepSeek's power-off outline into a clean-state, exact-standby and BMC-reachability gate that cannot silently start the firmware flash.
independent_technical_reasoning: The row couples power state to a destructive flash, so a status bit alone is insufficient. The expected state and handoff can be defined by Project engineering; this supports conditional automation under explicit service-interruption ownership.
